title: Tasks in such cases are required to start in a Requested status, meaning they must receive explicit… (CVE-2026-133852)
description: flowintel, a case management application, has a logic flaw in task creation that allows tasks in privileged cases to bypass the required approval workflow. Specifically, tasks can be initialized with a Created status instead of the required Requested status in two scenarios involving templates. This flaw enables authenticated users with task or case creation privileges to activate tasks directly in privileged cases without supervisory approval, potentially exposing restricted content or unauthorized actions. The issue affects flowintel versions prior to 4.1.0.
